correctness.rationale: Every success branch is analyzed from the rank-one output condition. Equality of the local kernels reduces the antisymmetric support to one contributing vector, Schatten Hölder yields \(\operatorname{Tr}(XY)\ge2\sin(2\theta)|\alpha|^2\), and block-positivity of swap against the separable failure effect yields \(p\le[2\sin(2\theta)]^{-1}\). The explicit six-branch product-Kraus construction has success effect with coefficient \(2p\sin(2\theta)\) on \(|ii\rangle\) and \(p\) on \(|ij\rangle\), \(i\ne j\); the diagonal remainder is separable and the bound is attained.
